name: codex-local-worker
description: Plan with the model you selected in this window and implement with a pinned local worker model on your own machine. Setup checks and installs the user-wide routing (migrating the pre-rename pointer block), doctor verifies an existing install read-only, and the launcher runs scoped jobs in throwaway git worktrees, returning a patch, real test results and an audit of every changed file.
